Wrote a developer guide for Nano Banana 2 with the Gemini Interactions API. The guide walks you through 4 use cases.

📝 Text → Image: Generate a photorealistic Kyoto travel poster.
🔍 + Web Search: Ground images with real landmark facts.
🆕 + Image Search: Retrieve real photos for visual accuracy.
🧑 + Reference Photo: Composite a real person into scenes.
